Reconciles: 879,598.43 + 425,642.21 - 472,372.60 + 15,300 - 78,300 = 769,868.04. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (total 769,868.04 equals the government-wide governmental column p1), business-type line and totals from the Statement of Net Position p1.
